notes.title: Winter Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy Holidays!🎄[/h1]
[h3]This Winter Update adds a splash of festive joy to Bird Simulator 24 with the following:[/h3]

[h3]New Skin:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dress your crow in a cozy Holiday Sweater to celebrate the season in style.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231007/0c0da48a1ae037f2901020d0df63d429865ed6fa.png[/img]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enchanced object grabbing system
[*] You can no longer poop on yourself
[*] Changed location of one of the secret hats
[/list]

Don’t forget to grab the game during the Winter Sale and experience the chaos like never before! 
[h1]Now with a 30% off discount![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3262870/Bird_Simulator_24/
Thank you for your ongoing support, and stay tuned for more updates.

Enjoy the festivities and happy gaming! 🐦✨
